name: Vnutri
source:
The protagonist is an ordinary student from Canada named Nathan Sullivan. He considers himself an educated and intelligent person, but the guy has already committed his ultimate act of stupidity. He decided to read a motivational book for girls on a dare.

The idea was noble. He wanted to prove to his friend Rachel that after reading such books, a person would lose their grip on rationality and things would go wrong with their head. Congratulations to him, he proved it. Now all that is left is to get rid of the madness. A madness in the form of a plump, dim-witted lady living inside his head.
